summary: The Formula of Concord, which the Lutheran Church-Missouri Synod holds, teaches that the Holy Scriptures alone remain the only judge, rule and standard by which all teachings are to be tested. The creeds and confessions are not judges as Scripture is; they are only a testimony and declaration of the faith, of how Scripture has been understood. The text read does not list the books of Scripture.

points.question: What is Scripture's authority?
points.answer: Scriptures alone remain the only judge, rule and standard by which all doctrines must be discerned as good or evil, right or wrong.

points.question: What of the creeds and confessions?
points.answer: They are not judges as Scripture is, but a testimony and declaration of the faith, showing how the Scriptures have at any time been understood.
